integrity: Full proof, Fourier positivity criterion, explicit optimizer witnesses, dual bounds, source comparisons, and runnable standard-library verification are included.
scientific_limitations: The scalar optimum for the corresponding square of an even cycle is prior literature. Novelty is restricted to the entire complex noncommutative positive-definite equality face. No assertion is made concerning non-group-invariant theta SDP solutions. Finite numerical checks do not establish universal validity, and an implicit prior equality classification cannot be fully excluded.
title: Complex positive-type optimizer faces for a five-element dihedral neighborhood
